content:
It is my pleasure to announce the PuzzleScript implementation in Lean. PuzzleScript is a game engine for move-based puzzle games in a grid (such as Sokoban):
https://git.olsak.net/mirek/PuzzleLean

Enjoy!

What works well

  • Loading games in Puzzlescript format into Lean expressions
  • Playing games in the infoview
  • Proving solvability by loading solutions exported by the game widget, and checking via native_decide
  • Rich feature support & alignment with the original engine

What is missing

  • Reasoning infrastructure. In principle, it should be possible to prove any true property about the games but there are no theorems / helpers, and the engine was so far focusing on user interface & efficiency. 
  • Realtime games, and possibly some other features I haven't encountered in the 98 example games. 

P.S. Although it started as a pure vibe-coding project, nontrivial part of the code is currently human written, most notably the core engine (rule matching & processing).
